register.aee_hook_pass: NOT RUN on this draft: the AEE lifecycle hooks (after_specify / after_plan / after_tasks) are a freeze gate, run at the freeze act over the recovered register (the Spec 035 ordering; see specs/037-cisi31-concordance-spine/aee/freeze-aee-note.md)

basis.decisions: The owner's draft order of 2026-10-20 commissions this draft only; no freeze order and no execution order exist for this contract. The study implemented is the CISI 3.1 intake's first two assessed candidate uses (intake report sections 7.5-7.6, 2026-10-20), over material held under the Phase-130 gate (restricted store PROVENANCE entry 22). DD-037-5, DD-037-6, and DD-037-7 are open proposals for the freeze decision; DD-037-4's halt threshold is draft-fixed for the freeze to confirm or change openly.

design.question_owner: the CISI 3.1 intake record (2026-10-20), candidate uses 1-2; no PRED-2026 entry is scored, advanced, or retired by this study
design.workstream_a: object-level concordance spine: verify the intake's 693 exact-string matches between the portion's catalogue numbers and corpus_master object ids as same-object joins under the fixed ladder (spec section 4.3); build the spine from VERIFIED joins only, as a LOCAL table in the restricted store; report aggregate statistics only
design.workstream_b: HARP provenance annex (descriptive): dig-year, lot, and period-code inventories and distributions from the HARP rows of the same local table, with the period-fill floor caveat; it does not change the Spec 031 (Q7) record and feeds no verdict

pilot.form: census of all candidates, not a sample (DD-037-2)
ladder: site agreement (mandatory; the fixed section-to-site mapping)
object-type agreement (mandatory where graded; closed class set; a seal and a seal impression are different classes)
corroborating keys (FC number, excavation number, museum/registration) where both sides carry a value: contradiction is a conflict; absence is UNGRADED
number-level ambiguity (the portion's own records under one number conflict) bars VERIFIED

halt_rule.on_halt: the pilot completes and reports in full; no spine file is written; the outcome is PILOT COMPLETE - SPINE HALTED

pilot.hand_check_stratum: seeded random sample stratified across the three outcome classes, attributing each sampled conflict to intake extraction error, programme-side record error, genuine compilation divergence, or true non-identity; its size is the DD-037-5 freeze proposal (draft proposal: 60)

design.reported_aggregates: outcome counts and shares overall, by portion section, and by corpus source; conflict breakdown by reason code; per-field graded bases; the stratum's cause attribution; spine coverage and field fill; the annex distributions - aggregate statistics only, never rows

fences.string_match: an exact-string match is a candidate, never a join
fences.finding_aid: the concordance is a finding aid, not evidence about readings
fences.no_pred_scoring: the Basic data tables carry no sign transcriptions (zero sign tokens), so no PRED-2026 entry can be scored from this material
fences.q7: the annex does not change the Spec 031 (Q7) finding: in-universe link mass 2 sites / 1 pair; bead/craft NOT-YET-TESTABLE; ceramic NOT ESTIMABLE
fences.join_keys: Holdat cisi_number is prohibited as a join key (the Spec 034 discipline)

design.execution_gate: NOT satisfied: no freeze order and no execution order exist for this contract; the freeze and the execution (Phase-401) are separate future owner decisions; this draft performs neither, computes no join, and extracts nothing
